target_customer: Drive-thru restaurant operators and offline retail chains
problem: Operators miss upsell chances and stock issues because order conversations are never analyzed.
business_model: B2B SaaS analytics on recorded customer conversations

founders.name: Sasha Miagkyi
founders.background_notes: Product Hunt profile summary calls him CEO; YC bio says he builds software to sell food.

founders.name: Igor Shelvinskyi
founders.background_notes: YC bio: about 10 years in machine learning and NLP.

competitors.name: Hi Auto
competitors.what: Conversational AI for drive-thru ordering and Window Intelligence analytics
competitors.traction_then: first deployment at Lee's Famous Recipe Chicken

competitors.name: ConverseNow
competitors.traction_then: live in over 750 stores in 2021, Domino's flagship

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech analysis in noisy drive-thru lanes is hard for a five person team.

defensibility.rationale: Conversation data could compound but voice AI rivals were well funded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals consolidated, for example ConverseNow bought Valyant AI in 2024 per Restaurant Business; no source shows an Outloud purchase.

market_need_then: Drive-thru voice AI drew rapid vendor activity in 2021 as labor shortages grew.

branding.domain_note: Used outloud.ai (.ai domain); a different Outloud AI app appeared on Product Hunt in 2025.

brand_strength.rationale: Only directory listings; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Outloud raised small amounts ($50K from the Ukrainian Startup Fund, an undisclosed Digital Future round, about $225K total per PitchBook) and faced well funded drive-thru voice rivals such as Presto, Hi Auto and ConverseNow. PitchBook marks it Out of Business and YC lists it Inactive, but no cause is stated; the could not raise factor is inferred from the small total.
notes: Shutdown rests on PitchBook and the YC directory; cause not public. Round amounts: Digital Future undisclosed; PitchBook total $225K (not opened). One profile claims bootstrapped, conflicting. Digital Future founder says a founder has Burger King experience; not tied to a named founder. outloud.ai fetch was rate limited. Competitor ConverseNow source date is year only.
